source.note: Devnet deployment; program keypairs and address registry in ~/.config/omnipair/dusk-devnet. Binary attested from chain (upgradeable loader programdata). The IDL moves with it. Previous binary (72aa2ddf…) preserved at dusk-keepers/artifacts/dusk-devnet-72aa2ddf.so for rollback. source.worktreeFingerprintSha256 covers programs/ and is reproduced by scripts/compute-worktree-fingerprint.mjs.
